role.zh: 硕士研究生 · 大连理工大学

interests.zh: 机器人导航 · 运动规划 · 视觉语言动作模型

bio.en: Hi, I'm Bing Sun, a master's student in the IIAU Lab at Dalian University of Technology, with graduation expected in June 2027.
bio.zh: 你好，我是孙冰，目前在大连理工大学 IIAU Lab 攻读硕士学位，预计于 2027 年 6 月毕业。

bio.en: My research focuses on autonomous robot navigation, motion planning, and task understanding and action generation with vision–language–action (VLA) models. I work on connecting perception, planning, and learned control policies for real robots.
bio.zh: 我的研究方向是机器人自主导航、运动规划，以及基于视觉语言动作（VLA）模型的任务理解与动作生成，关注感知、规划与学习控制策略在真实机器人上的融合与应用。

bio.en: During my internship at RoboScience, I worked on semantic mapping and navigation, robotic parcel sorting, and long-horizon tea preparation. I also participated in multi-agent research through a Tsinghua University exchange and an NSFC major project.
bio.zh: 在 RoboScience 实习期间，我参与了语义建图与自主导航、机器人快递分拣及长程茶艺操作。在清华大学交流及国家自然科学基金重大项目中，我参与了多智能体协同对抗研究。

title.en: Learning Direct Control from Optimization for Dynamic Target Tracking
title.zh: 从优化中学习直接控制，实现动态目标跟踪

description.en: Transfers trajectory optimization objectives into differentiable losses and backpropagates through kinematic integration to learn a control policy. The method combines target visibility, obstacle clearance, and control smoothness with decaying expert guidance, a predictive safety lock, and a classical planning fallback.
description.zh: 将传统轨迹优化目标转化为可微损失，通过运动学积分实现轨迹级损失向控制策略的端到端反向传播。融合目标可见性、障碍物距离与控制平滑性约束，并结合衰减式专家引导、预测性安全锁及经典规划控制回退策略。

result.en: Across tested obstacle densities, linear-velocity jerk RMS decreased by 33.2%–47.6% relative to the next-best baseline; computation took 4.25–5.63 ms per cycle, with success rates above 80%. Validated on HUNTER 2.0 and Unitree G1-D platforms.
result.zh: 在所测试的不同障碍物密度下，线速度 Jerk RMS 较次优方法降低 33.2%–47.6%，单周期计算时间为 4.25–5.63 ms，成功率超过 80%；在 HUNTER 2.0 阿克曼底盘和宇树 G1-D 平台上完成实机验证。

title.en: UCON: Uncertainty-aware Navigation with Historical Re-association in Dynamic Environments
title.zh: UCON：动态环境中基于历史重关联的不确定性感知导航

author.en: Bing Sun, Yue Lin, Yongsheng Yuan, Yang Liu, Dong Wang, Huchuan Lu
author.zh: 孙冰，林跃，袁永胜，刘洋，王栋，卢湖川

description.en: Uses point-level reassociation with historical point-cloud segments and Kalman filtering to maintain dynamic-object tracking through occlusions, missed detections, and identity switches. Predicted states and covariances form uncertainty sectors that translate dynamic collision risk into differentiable trajectory costs.
description.zh: 针对遮挡、漏检和 ID 切换，设计基于历史点云片段的点级重关联机制，结合卡尔曼滤波进行目标状态估计与协方差传播。基于预测状态与协方差构建不确定性扇区，将动态碰撞风险转化为可微轨迹代价。

result.en: Evaluated in complex dynamic environments through simulation and experiments on an omnidirectional mobile robot.
result.zh: 在复杂动态环境中开展仿真及全向移动机器人实验，验证感知与规划联合方法的有效性。

title.zh: 基于 π0.5 的长程茶艺操作

description.en: Built a pipeline for data collection, cleaning, policy training, and real-robot deployment. Used DINO visual features, stage-wise trajectory annotation, failure analysis, key-segment resampling, and DAgger correction data to improve long-horizon execution.
description.zh: 搭建数据采集、清洗、策略训练与真机部署链路。引入 DINO 视觉特征，围绕阶段切换、误差累积及失败恢复建立分阶段轨迹标注和失败归因机制，结合关键片段重采样与 DAgger 纠错数据优化长程执行。

result.en: Real-robot validation includes teapot lid opening and water pouring for brewing; longer task sequences are being refined.
result.zh: 完成系统集成与真机测试，已实现茶壶开盖和倒水冲泡步骤，并持续优化更长任务序列的执行能力。

title.en: VLA Policies for Robotic Parcel Sorting
title.zh: 快递分拣 VLA 策略训练与实机部署

description.en: Trained, compared, and deployed GR00T and π0.5 policies with an end-to-end teleoperation, preprocessing, fine-tuning, and online inference pipeline. Improved generalization under occlusion, complex stacking, and out-of-distribution states through scene stratification, trajectory screening, expert corrections, and data-mixture ablations.
description.zh: 基于 GR00T 和 π0.5 开展训练、性能对比与真机部署，搭建遥操作采集、数据预处理、策略微调和在线推理链路。针对包裹遮挡、复杂堆叠与分布外失败，结合场景分层、轨迹筛选、专家纠错及数据配比消融改善泛化表现。

result.en: Real-robot testing achieved a 97% task success rate and a sorting throughput of 1,139 parcels per hour.
result.zh: 真实机器人测试中，任务成功率达到 97%，分拣速度达到 1,139 件/小时。

title.en: Semantic Mapping and Autonomous Warehouse Navigation
title.zh: 面向仓库环境的语义建图与自主导航

description.en: Fused object detection, semantic segmentation, point-cloud projection, and multi-frame observations to associate semantic categories with a 2D occupancy map. Integrated semantic destinations and region constraints into ROS 2 Nav2 for global planning, dynamic obstacle avoidance, and mobile-base control.
description.zh: 融合目标检测、语义分割、点云投影与多帧观测，实现语义类别与二维占据地图的空间关联。基于 ROS 2 Nav2 集成全局规划、局部动态避障及底盘控制，将语义目标点和区域约束融入导航任务。

result.en: Integrated and deployed the perception-to-control system for navigation to specified shelves and work areas.
result.zh: 完成从感知、建图到规划控制的系统联调与部署，实现面向指定货架和工作区域的自主导航。

description.en: Worked on dynamic target tracking, motion prediction, and coordinated pursuit for 3v3 multi-agent tasks. Developed motion planning algorithms and adapted them to different robot kinematics, obstacle avoidance requirements, and real-time control interfaces.
description.zh: 面向 3v3 多智能体任务，开展动态目标跟踪、运动状态预测与协同围剿策略研究。开发运动规划算法，并针对不同平台的运动学、障碍规避与实时控制需求完成适配。

result.en: Deployed and evaluated on Mecanum-wheel, Ackermann, and omnidirectional robots, as well as UAVs, in indoor ramps and outdoor forest environments.
result.zh: 支持麦克纳姆轮、阿克曼轮、全向轮移动机器人及无人机，在室内坡道和室外森林环境中完成部署与实验验证。
